Exterior architectural photograph of a monumental elevated space station,
viewed from an exposed outdoor causeway approaching the station.
The camera is outside the structure, standing on the open bridge,
looking forward and slightly upward toward the station.

A broad, disk-shaped brutalist platform occupies the perspective vanishing point,
supported by a massive central tower extending downward into the clouds.
The entire outer rim, roof, underside, and exposed structural supports
are visible. A small central dome and slender antenna spire rise from
the platform.

The long uncovered causeway extends from the bottom foreground toward
the station, creating strong converging perspective lines. 
Prominent lush vertical gardens are clearly visible on the exterior station.
Dense planted bands wrap around the broad circular platform rim.
Long, unmistakable curtains of vines hang vertically from the platform's
outer edge and underside, extending visibly downward past the support
beams. Distinct green foliage contrasts with the red planet and warm sunset lighting. Keep the station's flattened disk silhouette and causeway unobstructed.

Low parapets
border the bridge; nothing covers the camera or walkway. Tiny human
figures on the causeway establish the enormous scale.

An enormous rust-red planet fills the sky behind the station.
A small pale moon appears near the planet’s upper-right edge.
